response.sql: WITH invoice_metrics AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as avg_quantity, AVG(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost <> 0 THEN (derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / derived_total_cost ELSE NULL END) as relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) as overall_avg_quantity FROM invoice_metrics) SELECT im.invoice_number, im.avg_quantity, im.relative_gap, im.avg_quantity - oa.overall_avg_quantity as qty_above_avg FROM invoice_metrics im CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE im.avg_quantity IS NOT NULL AND im.avg_quantity > oa.overall_avg_quantity ORDER BY qty_above_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
